headword: {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}
reading: にっぽんぎんこうけん
gloss: Bank of Japan note; Japanese banknote

definitions.gloss: Bank of Japan note; Japanese banknote
definitions.explanation: The official designation for paper money issued by the Bank of Japan. The phrase appears printed on every Japanese banknote, just above the denomination.

examples.japanese: {紙幣|しへい}には「{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}」と{書|か}いてある。
examples.english: "Bank of Japan Note" is printed on the bill.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}が{発行|はっこう}された。
examples.english: New Bank of Japan notes have been issued.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}は{日本|にほん}の{法定通貨|ほうていつうか}である。
examples.english: Bank of Japan notes are Japan's legal tender.

notes:
The formal legal name for Japanese paper currency. In daily life people simply say {紙幣|しへい} (banknote) or お{札|さつ} (bill); {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん} appears mainly on the bills themselves and in financial or legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}{発行高|はっこうだか}: amount of Bank of Japan notes in circulation
- {新|しん}{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}: new-design Bank of Japan notes
- {旧|きゅう}{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}: old-design Bank of Japan notes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {紙幣|しへい}: banknote — everyday term
- お{札|さつ}: bill — colloquial
- {硬貨|こうか}: coin — issued by the government, not the Bank of Japan
